name: In Bloom
source:
Made for the MAYbe Queer Jam, In Bloom is a very short kinetic novel with roughly 3 minutes of gameplay. There are no choices to be made, nothing to stress over. Just a story being told.

[From [url=https://vhsdreamland.itch.io/in-bloom]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《In Bloom》为MAYbe Queer Jam创作，是一部流程约三分钟的超短篇无选项视觉小说。没有需要做出的选择，也没有需要担心的事，只有一个娓娓道来的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vhsdreamland.itch.io/in-bloom]itch.io[/url]]
